svg.title: Antibody
svg.desc: Y-shaped IgG with paired heavy chains, paired light chains, hinge, Fc stem, and two antigen-binding tips. Biological basis: Immunoglobulin heavy and light variable domains form two antigen-binding sites, while the Fc region recruits immune effector mechanisms.
